module autovcoder_024097 (
    clk1,
    clk2,
    rst1_b,
    rst2_b,
    sync_in,
    sync_out
);

  // &Ports; @25
  input clk1;
  input clk2;
  input rst1_b;
  input rst2_b;
  input sync_in;
  output sync_out;

  // &Regs; @26
  reg  sync_ff1_clk1;
  reg  sync_ff2_clk1;
  reg  sync_ff_clk2;

  // &Wires; @27
  wire clk1;
  wire clk2;
  wire rst1_b;
  wire rst2_b;
  wire sync_in;
  wire sync_out;


  //==============================================================================
  // sync logic from clk2 to clk1
  // step 1. flop once in clk2 domain
  // step 2. flop twice in clk1 domain
  // constraint: slow clock --> fast clock
  //==============================================================================

  always @(posedge clk2 or negedge rst2_b) begin
    if (!rst2_b) sync_ff_clk2 <= 1'b0;
    else sync_ff_clk2 <= sync_in;
  end

  always @(posedge clk1 or negedge rst1_b) begin
    if (!rst1_b) begin
      sync_ff1_clk1 <= 1'b0;
      sync_ff2_clk1 <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      sync_ff1_clk1 <= sync_ff_clk2;
      sync_ff2_clk1 <= sync_ff1_clk1;
    end
  end

  assign sync_out = sync_ff2_clk1;

  // &ModuleEnd; @58
endmodule
